data.design: On the blue-reed ceramic plate; whole before the meal, empty plate retained afterwards.

description:
A warm homemade pie under a tea towel, made from the seller’s City 4 recipe. Mother recognizes it, gives the child the larger slice and shares crumbs with a household companion. The pleasure of eating together should be allowed to last without a sinister reversal.

Flaking crust, scraped forks and the soft sound of eating.
